primary_rule: Maximize the minimum expected placement payout over retained freshly CDF-screened fields, with lexicographic exact ties. Report the full frozen pool and all 101 C2/C4 splits separately. Equal weighting over model scenarios is not inferred.
scope: All 40 supplied families, 40 leave-one-family-out fits, 12 predefined within-family catalog variants, and every C2/C4 split. Deliberate pure-family and replacement stresses stay separate from score-compatible model comparisons. No claim of optimality against every possible population.
